title: Complete Classification of Target-Law Recovery in Three-Item Missing-Not-at-Random Graphs
banked_reason: TERMINAL_FOR_THIS_RUN: construction-intractable, not theorem-false; no concrete bounded route exists to the required exact compiler.
gap_reasons: after retry there are still no mask-indexed NBS weights, lower-level traces, checker transcripts, per-trace operation counts, or lexicographically first failed mask
Compile the Nabi--Bhattacharya--Shpitser unnormalized odds-ratio weights for each of the 496 no-self-censoring/no-colluder masks into accepted L3 traces
Classify the determinant-zero positive stratum of residual case 6 and construct accepted certificates for all strata of all 34 canonical residual graphs.
proof_attempt_summary: D-0.5 accepted the corrected Complete3 angle at field tier. Two exact-target D0 attempts attacked the 496-mask denominator-safe reduction compiler: the first widened the certificate language unfaithfully and was discarded; the second derived a universal NBS normalizer cancellation but emitted no mask-indexed weights, executable checker traces, operation ledger, or concrete failed-mask obstruction. A neutral validity gate classified the run as construction-intractable rather than theorem-false because implementing the AST/checker and 742 exhaustive traces would still leave the research-level 34-row exceptional-stratum ledger unresolved.
tldr: On a deliberately stronger full-support finite model than the response-kernel positivity standard in the missing-data literature, a finite certificate calculus classifies uniform recovery of the eight-cell target law for all \(12800\) binary three-item conditional-MNAR DAGs. The novel kernel is the \(34\)-class residual dichotomy, its canonical machine-checkable ledger with an explicit exceptional-stratum rational-inverse audit, the sound-and-complete \(\operatorname{Complete}_3\) equivalence, and a strict acceptance frontier over both published fixing procedures. The odds-ratio graph already identified by Nabi, Bhattacharya, and Shpitser and reported as an intervention-tree false negative by Guo and Nabi is retained only as an executable regression exhibit. Every accepted formula has rule-by-rule positive observed-marginal divisors and compiles to joint multinomial inference on fixed interior subclasses.
gap: Nabi, Bhattacharya, and Shpitser give a complete criterion for the full law but explicitly leave target-law completeness open. Grouped fixing and intervention trees provide complementary constructive sufficient procedures, and their known odds-ratio false negative does not supply the missing converse. Rank-based colluder results do not answer the graph-uniform question on positive rank-degenerate strata.
fill: The project builds a typed hybrid certificate language with a rule-by-rule divisor theorem, constructs a canonical \(34\)-row outcome ledger carrying exact exceptional-stratum inverse tests, proves the ledger yields a total sound-and-complete classifier with a numerical operation bound, and compiles accepted rational formulas into joint multinomial inference.
